cd /workspace && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native PYTHONPATH=/workspace/vendor:/workspace/submission timeout 300 python3 -c "
import sys, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import planner
from gen2 import gen_case
rng = random.Random(0)
case = gen_case(rng, 64, 32, 8, 4)
log=[]
orig_b = planner._block_b
state={'k':0}
def b(net,cap):
    before=list(net.wdist)
    r=orig_b(net,cap)
    cnt=0; mag=0
    for x,y in zip(before,net.wdist):
        if y<x: cnt+=1; mag+= x-y
    state['k']+=1
    if len(log)<400: log.append((state['k'],cnt,mag))
    return r
planner._block_b=b
res=planner.solve_epoch(case)
for e in log[:80]: print(e)
print('...')
# find a slow run
i=0
runs=[]
while i < len(log):
    j=i
    while j<len(log) and log[j][1]>0: j+=1
    runs.append((i,j-i))
    i=j+1
runs.sort(key=lambda x:-x[1])
print('longest improving runs', runs[:5])
" 2>&1 | tail -30
